text.card: A red giant 9,595 parsecs away, 39 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 2.59 solar masses and 39.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,705 K at its surface.
